name: team-task-manager-backend
description: Backend API for Team Task Manager

scripts.postinstall: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');const fe=path.join(__dirname,'..','frontend');if(process.env.SKIP_FRONTEND_BUILD){console.log('Skipping frontend build (SKIP_FRONTEND_BUILD set)');process.exit(0);}if(!fs.existsSync(path.join(fe,'package.json'))){console.log('Frontend dir not found, skipping build');process.exit(0);}console.log('Building frontend at',fe);require('child_process').execSync('npm install --legacy-peer-deps && npm run build',{cwd:fe,stdio:'inherit'});"
